bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust Records $95 Million Outflow
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) experienced a $95 million net outflow on November 3, 2026, as part of a broader three-day withdrawal trend across spot Bitcoin ETFs.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Keel Infrastructure CEO Discusses Challenges of Transitioning to AI Data Centers
bitcoin_articles.summary: Keel Infrastructure CEO Ben Gagnon reports that the company has yet to sign customer contracts for its new data centers as it navigates a volatile market transition from Bitcoin mining.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Block, Inc. Reports Q3 Bitcoin Holdings in 10-Q Filing
bitcoin_articles.summary: Block, Inc. disclosed in its third-quarter 10-Q filing that it held 9,237 bitcoins as of September 30, 2026.
